```python
def has_required_scope(conn: HTTPConnection, scopes: typing.Sequence[str]
    ) ->bool:
    auth_credentials: AuthCredentials = conn.scope.get("auth", AuthCredentials())
    return any(scope in auth_credentials.scopes for scope in scopes)
```
